rule: D49 rule 3 (the owner's counting rule): each page template under "Coded records only", translated by this tree's page translator with no options (profile 1.3; the joint profile for Tree and Graph), pooled over the declared seeds: at least 30 patients with a store candidate and an index window, and at most 30% of the distinct child types (PLAN keys; C001 is reference) with a candidate unresolved (a type is unresolved when any of its candidates is); none of the five refused. All candidates and the count without C001 reported; the templates under stated findings reported beside

setting.window: from the first seizure, 24 months (the page's own)
setting.free_text: off (Coded records only); reported beside it: present (stated findings)
setting.translator: trajectory/store_request.js as committed (STORE_CODED_ONLY and STORE_GENE_CODED_ONLY true), no options
setting.store: store_parity.py build (the converter emitting series, through the gene wrapper) and match (store_conditions.match, the count post-pass on)

independence: not independent children (D36 review, M1): C001 is the scripted reference child in every seed, and every other child takes archetype, sex, birth year and overrides from the generator's fixed PLAN; only the draws vary with the seed
